dreams.text: The machine sleeps and sees EPSTEIN priced in WINTER, traded by no one.
The oracle dreams of ELECTION devouring ICE, and wakes unsure which won.
The press prints a future where GOOGLE forgets it was ever about TRUMP.
Far ahead, VENEZUELA and ASSEMBLY merge into a single word no one can pronounce.
By the year nobody counts to, EPSTEIN is law and WINTER is myth.
In the dream, FIFA crosses every chasm at once and finds ICE already there.
